# Concrete runtime Keeper identities forbidden in tracked OCaml source.
# Protocol roles such as verifier, operator, reviewer, and executor are not
# runtime Keeper identities and intentionally remain valid collision fixtures.
#
# The fresh-install roster's Keeper is deliberately absent: this list is matched
# as a substring, and its name occurs inside ordinary English words that fill
# this tree. Adding it would fail every file holding "import" or "implementation"
# rather than catching a fixture collision. Nothing in OCaml source names it —
# Common.fresh_config_root_keeper_seed_target maps a directory, not a Keeper —
# so there is nothing here for this guard to protect.
